07 · CONTROLS AND SOURCES

What passed, what remains open and what was used

PASS confirms the tested evidence. CONFIRMED records an agreed Finance treatment. REVIEW requires correction or supporting detail. OPEN means the necessary control document was not supplied.
MODEL STATUS: REVIEW—
ControlExpectedActualDeltaStatusEvidence
01

Document extraction

Invoice and credit-note dates, references, tonnage, rates, ex-VAT, VAT and totals come from the supplied PDFs.

02

Weight-basis selection

Each invoice tonnage is tested against every complete weight column in its paired workbook. The exact matching basis is retained by document and load.

03

Master linkage

Mine and terminal tickets link the supplied load row to the 2026 master. Dispatch, received and billed weights are compared separately.

04

Credit allocation

Credits follow Finance's confirmed supporting schedules. The stated original invoice plus ticket or quantity evidence independently identifies the reversed load.
